sentences: Mixed-item allocation permits items that an agent regards as beneficial or burdensome.
The recorded question asks for EF1 together with Pareto optimality under additive utilities.
Removing a good from another bundle and removing a chore from one's own bundle can affect envy in different ways.
A general existence or computation result would extend a central fairness–efficiency pairing beyond all-goods settings.
The source title does not specify the mixed EF1 convention or whether the target is existence versus efficient construction, so those choices must be kept explicit.
